name: PG Electroplast Ltd
title: PG Electroplast Ltd - 533581 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA fell 43% to INR131.5 crore on LPG and truck disruptions and ~250bp unrecovered gross-margin hit, while management guides FY27 growth and ~8% EBITDA margin without hard numbers.

utilisation.quote: average utilization is normally in AC business is around 50%, 45% to 50%

capex.quote: we will continue to invest in our strategic products, the refrigerant plant, the compressor facility and washing machine expansion while maintaining our discipline on returns.

triggers.label: Channel inventory normalised
triggers.quote: channel inventory have now normalized materially from the peak of approximately 5 million units

triggers.label: Gross margin hit ~250bp unrecovered
triggers.quote: Commodity inflation and currency depreciation resulted in estimated gross margin impact of approximately 250 basis points during the quarter

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA margin towards 8%
triggers.quote: We expect EBITDA margins to improve towards 8% as operating leverage returns

triggers.label: Inventory target below INR900 crore by June
triggers.quote: thing should be less than INR900 crores in our opinion by June end

guidance.quote: For FY27, we are targeting better than industry revenue growth.
We expect EBITDA margins to improve towards 8% as operating leverage returns
upwards of 30%, 35% is what we think we should be able to do in washing machine.

guidance.value: Q4 FY27 start, 2 million units phase 1
guidance.quote: operations are expected to commence by quarter 4 of FY27. We will have a capacity of 2 million compressors in the first phase
We plan to start commercial production by quarter 4 of FY27
We should be able to utilize these assets and get to an asset turn of 4x plus by 2029.

guidance.value: total inventory below INR900 crore by June end
guidance.quote: thing should be less than INR900 crores in our opinion by June end.

red_flags.label: Forex loss and unhedged liabilities
red_flags.quote: the rupee has further up to now INR95.5. So those are the kind of things which are leading to the forex losses this year.

red_flags.label: Receivables stretched, higher borrowing
red_flags.quote: the receivable cycle was stretched, leading to higher borrowing utilization and therefore, the higher interest cost resulted.

red_flags.label: Management avoids FY27 numbers
red_flags.quote: we don't want to take any risk of giving any numbers as of now.

evasions.quote: we don't want to take any risk of giving any numbers as of now.
I don't have those numbers right now. Maybe you can connect probably post maybe first week of June.
we will probably be in a better situation post June quarter to take a call on these things.
